title: AI Ecosystem Evolution Manager — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Evaluates which tools, agents, and databases should be added, improved, merged, or retired. A proposed manager for the whole AI ecosystem: it continuously evaluates which tools, agents, and databases should be added, improved, merged, or retired — based on usage, quality, overlap, and user needs — and proposes an evolution plan that humans approve. Nothing is retired without a migration path.
